evidence.detail: The class is the singleton-style daemon runtime loop initialized with the client host InetAddress; it services queued socket, thread, DNS, URL/file/audio requests from shared static request state.
It opens and owns the main RandomAccessFile plus five cache index RandomAccessFiles under the selected client data/cache path.
Public synchronized helpers request a Socket by port, resolve host names and open DataInputStreams from URL/code-base resources through the runtime loop.
The service starts daemon Runnables at caller-supplied priority, preserving the classic client background-work handoff role.
The runtime owns the live rs/w/c MidiPlayer and coordinates queued audio/MIDI save/playback work in the same service loop.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the legacy client runtime/signlink-style service. The historical source identifier 'Signlink' is not claimed as recovered authority.
